## Original article text

````markdown
This event type triggers for a player when they receive healing from another player or themself and the `Conditions` evaluate to `True`.

#### Arguments

*  [Team](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/team) - The team(s) checked by the event.
*  [Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/player) - The player(s) checked by the event based on slot number or hero.

#### Contextual Values

*  [Event Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+player) - The player that triggered the event.
*  [Event Healing](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+healing) - The amount of healing received by `Event Player`.
*  [Healer](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/healer) - The player restoring health to the healee. Will have the same value as `Healee` when self-healing.
*  [Healee](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/healee) - The player receiving health. In this context, it has the same value as `Event Player`.
*  [Event Was Health Pack](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+was+health+pack) - Wether the healing event was triggered by a health pack.
*  [Event Ability](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+ability) - The ability used by the `Healer`.
*  [Event Direction](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+direction) - The incoming direction from the source of healing to the `Healee`.
````
